---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new effect, pattern, or capability
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What kind of addition is this?**
- [ ] New effect (image / text / audio / video / web)
- [ ] New generative pattern
- [ ] New media type / tab
- [ ] UI / workflow improvement
- [ ] Something else

**Describe what you want**
A clear description of the effect/feature and what it should look or feel
like when used.

**Have you checked for overlap?**
Take a look through `patterns/registry.js` and the relevant
`effects/<media>/` files first — a few contributions have had to be
reworked because they collided with or too closely duplicated something
that already existed. Mention here what you checked.

**Why this is worth adding**
What does this make possible that isn't possible today?

**Are you willing to implement it?**
- [ ] Yes, I'd like to submit a PR
- [ ] No, just suggesting
